verses.1: And the Philistines took away the Ark of God. They brought it back from the land of Ashdod.
verses.2: And the Philistines took the Ark of God and brought it into the house of Dagon. They displayed it before Dagon.
verses.3: And they gathered them from the evening, and behold, Dagon fell to the ground before them. They took Dagon and placed him back in his place.
verses.4: In the morning, from the evening, behold! Dagon fell before him. He lay on the ground in front of the altar of Yahweh. The head of Dagon and both of his hands were torn off. But Dagon remained on it.
verses.5: Therefore, the priests of Dagon and all those who come from the house of Dagon shall not enter the temple of Dagon on this day.
verses.6: And the hand of the LORD was with the Ashdodites. They were defeated, and they were scattered across various places. The Ashdodites and their borders were destroyed.
verses.7: And the people of Ashdod saw this, and they said, “Let no one from the gods of Israel sit with us, for his hand is against us and against our gods.”
verses.8: And they sent and gathered all the idols of the Philistines to them. They said, “What will be done to the temple of the God of Israel?” They said, “Let us take away the temple of the God of Israel.” And they did take away the temple of the God of Israel.
verses.9: And after that, they took him away. Then the hand of Jehovah was upon the great city of Megiddo. He destroyed all the people in that city, from the smallest to the largest. They were put to death by the enemy.
verses.10: And they sent out the Ark of God. The Ark was carried away, and the people cried out, “They have taken away the Ark of Israel to kill me and my people.”
verses.11: And they sent out and gathered together all the soldiers of Philistia. They said, “Send back the army of Israel, so that it may return to its place. Do not kill me and my people, as if we were dead in the entire city. The hand of God is upon that place.”
verses.12: And those people who did not die, were raised from the dead. And the river of the city was filled with blood.
